title: Fix stale 404 links caught by URL lint
body:
Addresses the 404 link-rot portion of #189557.

This PR updates or removes stale URLs reported by the nightly `lint-urls` job:

- Updates moved PyTorch documentation links to current working pages.
- Removes hyperlinks where the referenced page or issue no longer has a reliable replacement.
- Updates the ROCm PR reference from `ROCm/clr` to `ROCm/rocm-systems`.
- Rewords the deleted `pytorch/data` issue link as a descriptive regression-test comment.

The `hud.pytorch.org` `000` failures are left unchanged because the issue notes they may be transient/rate-limit related rather than dead links. I did not add `@lint-ignore` for those URLs in this PR; if maintainers prefer suppressing those flaky checks, I can follow up separately.

Validation:

- Verified the stale 404 URLs are present on `upstream/main`.
- Verified the same stale URL patterns are absent on `fix-stale-doc-links`.
- Ran `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`.
